Usage & active practice

Again: retry after a few cards and due in 1 minute. Hard: short interval. Good / Easy: increasingly spaced reviews. Ratings are your assessment, not automatic grading.

How this practice works

Each verb meaning has its own review schedule. Nouns use English cues and require the German article shown in your source image. Labeled noun scenes stay hidden until you reveal. Cards are mixed across subjects, due reviews come first, and up to 10 new cards enter a smart session. Previous/Next never changes your progress.

Intervals are a simple spaced-review heuristic, not a guarantee of retention. Noun text was imported from your image labels and may contain source or OCR errors; check the displayed source scene when uncertain. The source includes some plural and inflected forms. No unverified singular or plural forms have been invented.

Progress stays in this browser, separately from the original verb browser. Export it as a backup or to move devices. Audio depends on browser voices.
